injuries.name: Saquon Barkley
injuries.note: Barkley (left arm) said after Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers that he believes he'll play in Thursday's game at Dallas, Johnny McGonigal of PennLive.com reports.

injuries.name: Jonathan Jones
injuries.note: Jones (foot) was spotted in a walking boot following Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers, Dave Zangaro of NBC Sports Philadelphia reports.

injuries.name: Quinyon Mitchell
injuries.note: Mitchell (hamstring) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Steelers.

injuries.name: Zack Baun
injuries.note: Baun (back) was placed on the Eagles' injured reserve Saturday.

injuries.name: Dontayvion Wicks
injuries.note: The Eagles placed Wicks (ankle/foot) on injured reserve Saturday.

injuries.name: Alex Highsmith
injuries.note: Highsmith (ankle) has been ruled out from returning to Sunday's matchup against Philadelphia, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
injuries.note: Pittman (foot) is not expected to be activated from injured reserve for Sunday's game against the Eagles, Brooke Pryor of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Gennings Dunker
injuries.note: The Steelers designated Dunker (knee) for return to practice from injured reserve Wednesday, Teresa Varley of the team's official site reports.

injuries.name: Mason McCormick
injuries.note: The Steelers placed McCormick (ankle) on injured reserve Wednesday, Teresa Varley of the team's official site reports.
